quizzes.title: WED and UNEP: MCQ practice
quizzes.passage: The booklet describes several environmental programmes in India, and this passage draws on a few of them. The Swachh Bharat Abhiyan was launched by the Prime Minister on Gandhi Jayanti in New Delhi, with the aim of making a Clean India by a date that marked the 150th birth anniversary of Mahatma Gandhi. Over the years, the mission has evolved into a National Movement. India's Plastics Pact is the first of its kind in Asia and was launched in collaboration with the Confederation of Indian Industries and the World Wide Fund for Nature. It is a business-led initiative that seeks to transform the plastics packaging value chain for all formats and products. The Aravalli Green Wall Project draws its inspiration from Africa's Great Green Wall and proposes a green belt of 1,400 km by 5 km along the Aravalli Range. Its purposes include halting desertification from the Thar Desert and improving air quality and biodiversity. Its other stated purposes are restoring degraded lands and ecosystems and building climate resilience. Mission LiFE is another initiative that was first introduced by the Prime Minister at COP 26 in Glasgow. It is described as an India-led global mass movement that aims to nudge individual and collective action to protect and preserve the environment.

questions.q: On which date is World Environment Day celebrated every year?
questions.explanation: World Environment Day is celebrated on June 5 every year.

questions.q: In which year was World Environment Day established to coincide with the opening of the Stockholm Conference on Human Environment?
questions.explanation: It was established in 1972 to coincide with the opening day of the Stockholm Conference on Human Environment.

questions.q: Which of the following is stated as a purpose of World Environment Day?
options: Raising awareness and driving global action on pressing environmental issues
Setting a binding plastic treaty for all member states
Raising the climate finance target to $2 trillion
questions.explanation: The booklet gives its purpose as raising awareness and driving global action on pressing environmental issues.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): The United Nations Environment Programme organises World Environment Day.
Reason (R): The United Nations Environment Programme is based in Nairobi, Kenya.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation: Both statements are true, but UNEP's location in Nairobi does not explain why it organises the day.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
I. UNEP was founded in 1972.
II. The headquarters of UNEP is in Geneva, Switzerland.
III. Brazil was named Global Host for World Environment Day 2026.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: UNEP was founded in 1972, but it is based in Nairobi, and Azerbaijan rather than Brazil was named Global Host for 2026.

questions.q:
Match List I with List II:
I. Global Host for World Environment Day 2026   ->   A. Only One Earth
II. Headquarters of UNEP   ->   C. June 5
III. Theme celebrated in 1973   ->   D. Nairobi, Kenya
IV. Date of World Environment Day   ->   B. Azerbaijan
questions.explanation: Azerbaijan is the 2026 Global Host, Nairobi is UNEP's base, Only One Earth was the 1973 theme and June 5 is the celebration date.

questions.q:
How many of the following statements are correct?
I. The 2026 theme of World Environment Day is 'Inspired by Nature. For Climate. For Our Future.'
II. World Environment Day is organised by UNEP.
III. The 2026 theme of World Environment Day is 'Ecosystem Restoration'.
questions.explanation: Statements I and II are correct, while III is wrong because the 2026 theme is 'Inspired by Nature. For Climate. For Our Future.'

quizzes.title: WED and UNEP: typed answers
quizzes.passage: Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam is a campaign that asks people to plant trees in memory of their mother, linking an emotional appeal with afforestation. The Compensatory Afforestation Fund Management and Planning Authority, known as CAMPA, has funds aimed at promoting afforestation and regeneration activities on waste, vacant and barren lands. Prakriti is the mascot used to spread greater awareness among masses about small changes that can be sustainably adopted in our lifestyle for a better environment. The year 2024 marked the 30th anniversary of the UN Convention to Combat Desertification. The 16th Session of its Conference of Parties was held in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, in the same year. The UN Decade on Ecosystem Restoration is another international effort. India also launched Project Elephant as a conservation project. The Aravalli Green Wall Project was inspired by Africa's Great Green Wall and proposes a green belt of 1,400 km by 5 km from Porbandar in Gujarat to Panipat in Haryana. The National Mission for Green India aims to increase forest and tree cover on 5 million hectares of land and to improve the quality of forest cover on another 5 million hectares. It is one of the missions under the National Action Plan on Climate Change.

questions.q: On which date is World Environment Day celebrated every year? (day and month)
questions.explanation: World Environment Day is celebrated on June 5 every year.

questions.q: In which year was World Environment Day established? (year)
questions.explanation: It was established in 1972, the year the Stockholm Conference on Human Environment opened.

questions.q: In which city is the headquarters of the UN Environment Programme located? (city)
questions.explanation: UNEP is based in Nairobi, Kenya.

questions.q: Which country was named Global Host for World Environment Day 2026? (country)
questions.explanation: Azerbaijan was named Global Host for World Environment Day 2026.

questions.q: What was the theme of World Environment Day celebrated in 1973? (three words)
questions.explanation: The 1973 celebration carried the theme 'Only One Earth'.

questions.q: Which body organises World Environment Day? (give the abbreviation)
questions.explanation: The United Nations Environment Programme organises World Environment Day.

questions.q: Which conference opened on the day that World Environment Day was established in 1972? (one word)
questions.explanation: World Environment Day was established to coincide with the opening day of the Stockholm Conference on Human Environment.

quizzes.title: Climate finance and the TFFF: MCQ practice
quizzes.passage: The booklet describes a new arrangement that serves as a modern foundational pillar for global climate finance. It sets an overarching target for scaling up climate funding to developing nations. The Tropical Forest Forever Facility is a separate vehicle that directly addresses the financial drivers of deforestation. Its focus is on tropical forests. India's climate commitments take a different form. Its Nationally Determined Contributions set targets on emissions intensity, non-fossil power capacity and carbon sinks. The updated submission made in 2022 raised the goals for 2030. The booklet also lists the UNFCCC, the carbon market, and Article 6 and 6.4 of the Paris Agreement under its skill-up heading. The International Solar Alliance was launched by India and France at COP-21 in Paris. The Alliance covers solar resource-rich States that lie between the Tropic of Cancer and the Tropic of Capricorn. Under the heading India's Contribution Towards Environmental Sustainability, the booklet lists the National Mission for Green India, introduced in 2014 as one of the missions under the National Action Plan on Climate Change. The mission aims to increase forest and tree cover on 5 million hectares. The mission also aims to improve the quality of forest and tree cover on another 5 million hectares.

questions.q: At which climate summit was the New Collective Quantified Goal on climate finance formally established?
questions.explanation: The NCQG was formally established during COP29 in Baku.

questions.q: What per-year climate funding target has been set for developing nations by 2035?
questions.explanation: The NCQG aims to scale up climate funding to developing nations to at least $1.3 trillion per year by 2035.

questions.q: How much have developed nations agreed to lead in annual mobilisation by 2035?
questions.explanation: Developed nations agreed to lead mobilisation of at least $300 billion annually by 2035.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): COP30 in Belém is widely termed the 'Amazon Forest COP'.
Reason (R): Belém is a city in Brazil.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation: Both statements are true, but the fact that Belém is in Brazil does not explain the 'Amazon Forest COP' nickname.

questions.q:
Match List I with List II:
I. Target for developing nations' climate funding per year by 2035   ->   A. COP30 in Belém
II. Developed nations' annual mobilisation by 2035   ->   B. $1.3 trillion
III. Formal establishment of the NCQG   ->   D. $300 billion
IV. Official launch of the TFFF   ->   C. COP29 in Baku
questions.explanation: The correct pairs are $1.3 trillion, $300 billion, COP29 in Baku and COP30 in Belém, in that order of the list.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
I. The TFFF makes standing, living tropical forests more economically valuable than cleared land.
II. COP30 in Belém is widely termed the 'Amazon Forest COP'.
III. Developed nations agreed to lead mobilisation of at least $1.3 trillion annually by 2035.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Statements I and II are correct, while III is wrong because $1.3 trillion is the developing-nations target, not the developed-nations figure.

questions.q:
How many of the following statements are correct?
I. The NCQG on climate finance was formally established at COP29 in Baku.
II. The TFFF was officially launched at the G20 Summit in New Delhi.
III. Developed nations agreed to lead mobilisation of at least $300 billion annually by 2035.
questions.explanation: Statements I and III are correct, while II is wrong because the TFFF was launched at COP30 in Belém.

quizzes.title: Climate finance and the TFFF: typed answers
quizzes.passage: The International Solar Alliance was jointly launched by India and France at COP-21 in Paris in 2015. It covers solar resource-rich States that lie fully or partially between the Tropic of Cancer and the Tropic of Capricorn. The Alliance was officially established on 6 December 2017, on the entry into force of the Framework Agreement. Its work includes addressing obstacles that stand in the way of a rapid and massive scale-up of solar energy. It also aims to reduce the cost of finance and the cost of technology for the immediate deployment of competitive solar generation. India's first NDC submitted in 2015 set targets for emissions intensity, non-fossil power capacity and carbon sinks. The updated NDC submitted in 2022 raised the goals for 2030. The skill-up list includes the UNFCCC, the carbon market and Article 6 and 6.4 of the Paris Agreement. The National Mission for Green India, introduced in 2014, is one of the missions under the National Action Plan on Climate Change. Its goal includes adding forest and tree cover on 5 million hectares of land. Articles 48A and 51A(g) of the Indian Constitution are also listed among these points. The First Assembly of the Alliance was held at Delhi.

questions.q: At which COP was the NCQG on climate finance formally established? (give the city)
questions.explanation: The NCQG was formally established during COP29 in Baku.

questions.q: Which city in Brazil hosted COP30, where the TFFF was launched? (give the city)
questions.explanation: The TFFF was officially launched at COP30 in Belém, Brazil.

questions.q: What is the NCQG per-year funding target for developing nations by 2035, in trillion dollars? (number)
questions.explanation: The NCQG aims to scale up climate funding to developing nations to at least $1.3 trillion per year by 2035.

questions.q: How many billion dollars a year have developed nations agreed to lead in mobilisation by 2035? (number)
questions.explanation: Developed nations agreed to lead mobilisation of at least $300 billion annually by 2035.

questions.q: Along with Brazil, which country's presidency is named in the Baku-Belém Roadmap? (country)
questions.explanation: The Baku-Belém Roadmap was designed to span the transition between the Azerbaijan and Brazil Presidencies.

questions.q: What nickname is widely given to COP30 in Belém? (three words)
questions.explanation: COP30 in Belém is widely termed the 'Amazon Forest COP'.

questions.q: Which facility, launched at COP30, makes standing tropical forests more economically valuable than cleared land? (abbreviation)
questions.explanation: The Tropical Forest Forever Facility makes standing forests more economically valuable than cleared land.

quizzes.title: India's NDC targets and the ISA: MCQ practice
quizzes.passage: India's national climate commitments are called Nationally Determined Contributions, and they set targets on emissions intensity, non-fossil power capacity and carbon sinks. The National Mission for Green India was introduced in 2014 as one of the missions under the National Action Plan on Climate Change. Its aim is to increase forest and tree cover on 5 million hectares of land, and to improve the quality of forest and tree cover on another 5 million hectares. The Aravalli Green Wall Project is inspired by Africa's Great Green Wall. It proposes a green belt of 1,400 km by 5 km along the Aravalli Range, running from Porbandar in Gujarat to Panipat in Haryana. Its purposes include halting desertification from the Thar Desert and restoring degraded lands and ecosystems. The project also aims to improve air quality, biodiversity and climate resilience. The Compensatory Afforestation Fund Management and Planning Authority, known as CAMPA, has funds aimed at promoting afforestation and regeneration activities on waste, vacant and barren lands. Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam is a campaign that asks people to plant trees in memory of their mother, linking an emotional appeal with afforestation. India's Plastics Pact is the first of its kind in Asia. It is a business-led initiative.

questions.q: In which year did India submit its updated NDC?
questions.explanation: The updated NDC was submitted in 2022.

questions.q: By how much did India's updated NDC propose to cut emissions intensity of GDP by 2030, from 2005 levels?
questions.explanation: The updated NDC targets a 45% cut in emissions intensity of GDP by 2030 from 2005 levels.

questions.q: On which date was the International Solar Alliance officially established?
questions.explanation: The ISA was officially established on 6 December 2017, on the entry into force of the Framework Agreement.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): The International Solar Alliance covers solar resource-rich States lying between the Tropics of Cancer and Capricorn.
Reason (R): The ISA was jointly launched by India and France in 2015.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation: Both statements are true, but the launch year does not explain which States the Alliance covers.

questions.q:
Match List I with List II:
I. First NDC: emissions intensity target for 2030   ->   C. 50%
II. Updated NDC: emissions intensity target for 2030   ->   A. 40%
III. First NDC: non-fossil capacity target for 2030   ->   D. 45%
IV. Updated NDC: non-fossil capacity target for 2030   ->   B. 33-35%
questions.explanation: The correct pairs are 33-35% for the first NDC, 45% for the updated NDC emissions target, 40% for the first NDC capacity target and 50% for the updated NDC capacity target.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
I. The first NDC, submitted in 2015, set a target of 40% non-fossil fuel based installed electric power capacity by 2030.
II. The updated NDC, submitted in 2022, set a 2030 target of a 33-35% cut in emissions intensity of GDP.
III. The ISA was officially established on 6 December 2017.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Statements I and III are correct, while II is wrong because the updated NDC's 2030 emissions intensity target is 45%.

questions.q:
How many of the following statements are correct?
I. The updated NDC targets a 45% cut in emissions intensity of GDP by 2030.
II. The ISA was jointly launched by India and France at COP-21 in Paris.
III. The ISA covers solar resource-rich States only in the Southern Hemisphere.
questions.explanation: Statement III is wrong because the ISA covers States lying between the Tropics of Cancer and Capricorn, which spans both hemispheres.

quizzes.title: India's NDC targets and the ISA: typed answers

The Green India mission aims to increase forest and tree cover on 5 million hectares of land. The Swachh Bharat Abhiyan was launched by the Prime Minister on Gandhi Jayanti in New Delhi. Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam is a campaign that asks people to plant trees in memory of their mother, linking an emotional appeal with afforestation.

questions.q: By what percentage did India's updated NDC propose to cut emissions intensity of GDP by 2030? (number)

questions.explanation: The ISA was officially established on 6 December 2017.

questions.q: Which agreement's entry into force led to the ISA's official establishment? (name)

questions.q: What percentage did India's first NDC set for non-fossil fuel based installed electric power capacity by 2030? (number)

questions.q: Between which two tropics do the ISA's solar resource-rich States lie? (name the northern one)
